description: The file defines a single Android activity class QaStartPlaybackActivity that starts playback immediately upon creation by initiating another activity (PlaybackActivity) and then finishes itself.

classes.name: QaStartPlaybackActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that starts playback immediately on creation by launching PlaybackActivity.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Lifecycle method override that initializes the activity, starts the playback activity, and finishes the current activity.
